Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

follow verb

advice, a rule, an example

also obey, comply with, go by, take advice, go by (the rules), keep the rules, observe (a rule)

classical

Cic. Sen. 5: nātūram optimam ducem tamquam deum sequimur
Cic. Fam. 4.3.2 (Lewis & Short: auctōritātem et cōnsilium alicujus)

sequor, sequī, secūtus sum

verb, third conjugation, deponent

follow (a guide, advice, an example)

To take someone or something as one’s guide: cōnsilium, auctōritātem, nātūram sequī.

Other words

  • pāreō, pārēre, pāruī, pāritum — obey

    verb, second conjugation, with the dative · also used · classical · Cic. Off. 2.40: lēgibus (Lewis & Short); Cic. Sen. 5: eīque pārēmus

    Of orders, rules and laws.

  • obtemperō, obtemperāre, obtemperāvī, obtemperātum — comply with, go by

    verb, first conjugation, with the dative · also used · classical · Cic. Fam. 2.7.2: tē audī, tibi obtemperā

    Of doing what someone advises or asks.

  • servō, servāre, servāvī, servātum — keep, observe (rules, laws)

    verb, first conjugation · also used · classical · Traupman 322

Examples

  • in hōc sumus sapientēs, quod nātūram optimam ducem tamquam deum sequimur eīque pārēmus

    this is where we are wise: we follow nature, the best of guides, as a god, and obey herCic. Sen. 5

  • tē audī, tibi obtemperā

    listen to yourself, follow your own adviceCic. Fam. 2.7.2

  • videō meliōra probōque, dēteriōra sequor

    I see the better course and approve of it; I follow the worseOv. Met. 7.20–21

See also follow, obedient.
